title: TRUER: Test-Time Reward Correction Using an Error-Aware Rectifier for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning enables language models to adapt using rewards derived from their own answers. However, majority voting can reinforce incorrect solutions even when correct alternatives are available. Our training audit shows that false positives (incorrect responses receiving positive rewards) dominate reward errors. We focus on a practical regime where ground-truth rewards are difficult to obtain at scale, while a limited labeled source set is available. We introduce TRUER, a framework that uses limited supervision to train a reward rectifier that distinguishes correctness from consensus. To achieve this goal, we train the rectifier with an emphasis on incorrect majorities and correct minorities, targeting cases where consensus and correctness disagree. translated_abstract: 测试时强化学习使语言模型能够利用从自身答案中派生的奖励进行自我适应。然而，即使存在正确的替代答案，多数投票机制仍可能强化错误的解决方案。我们的训练审计显示，假阳性（即错误响应却获得正奖励）是奖励误差的主要来源。我们关注一个实际场景：在该场景下，真值奖励难以大规模获取，但存在一个有限的带标签源数据集。我们提出了TRUER框架，该框架利用有限监督训练一个奖励校正器，用以区分正确性与共识。为实现这一目标，我们在训练校正器时重点针对错误多数和正确少数的情况，即共识与正确性不一致的情形。随后，我们冻结该校正器，并在后续的测试时适应过程中使用它来校正奖励。通过提高奖励准确性进而提升模型性能，TRU
tldr: TRUER框架利用有限的标注数据训练一个误差感知的奖励校正器，专门针对错误多数和正确少数的情形来区分正确性与多数共识，从而在测试时强化学习中校正奖励、提升奖励准确性和模型性能。
en_tdlr: TRUER leverages limited supervision to train an error-aware reward rectifier that distinguishes correctness from majority consensus—focusing on incorrect majorities and correct minorities—thereby correcting rewards during test-time RL adaptation and improving both reward accuracy and model performance.
